title.zh: 商业洗衣床品流转助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Receive and sort tagged linen while preserving customer identification and damage notes.
requirements.zh: 接收并分拣带标签床品，同时保留客户标识及损坏备注。

requirements.en: Record incoming linen quantities and distinguish gross weights from bag tare.
requirements.zh: 记录送洗床品数量，并区分毛重与洗衣袋扣除重量。

requirements.en: Prepare counted customer bundles, report shortages and hand over cart locations.
requirements.zh: 准备按件清点的客户包件、报告短缺，并交接推车位置。

requirements.en: Preferred: routine independent operation of a flatwork-finishing machine.
requirements.zh: 优先：日常独立操作平烫机的经验。
